apply_patch_freeform.used_when: modern GPT-5 models with grammar tool support
apply_patch_freeform.name: apply_patch
apply_patch_freeform.description: Use the `apply_patch` tool to edit files. This is a FREEFORM tool, so do not wrap the patch in JSON.
apply_patch_freeform.grammar:
start: begin_patch hunk+ end_patch
begin_patch: "*** Begin Patch" LF
end_patch: "*** End Patch" LF?

hunk: add_hunk | delete_hunk | update_hunk
add_hunk: "*** Add File: " filename LF add_line+
delete_hunk: "*** Delete File: " filename LF
update_hunk: "*** Update File: " filename LF change_move? change?

filename: /(.+)/
add_line: "+" /(.*)/ LF -> line

change_move: "*** Move to: " filename LF
change: (change_context | change_line)+ eof_line?
change_context: ("@@" | "@@ " /(.+)/) LF
change_line: ("+" | "-" | " ") /(.*)/ LF
eof_line: "*** End of File" LF

%import common.LF

public_output_shape.note: Tool output is plain text; richer patch begin/update/end information travels via events.

apply_patch_json.used_when: fallback for models without freeform grammar support

input.description: The entire contents of the apply_patch command
